item.title: AI Trade Reversal Pierces Asia’s Star Picks-and-Shovels Stocks
item.author: Bloomberg News (English)
item.description: For Asia, where chipmakers and the hardware suppliers that make printed-circuit boards, precision components and manufacturing equipment have been among the biggest beneficiaries of the AI frenzy, the implications could be significant heading into Monday’s open. A Goldman Sachs Group Inc. basket of regional AI hardware stocks tumbled 11% last week, its steepest decline since mid-July.
